The '''FT-7B Clarion''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[FT-series]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] starfighters produced by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. Similar to other models of the series, the Star Guard had two wings and four rear engines, and it featured [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on each wing. The Clarion lacked the weapon capacity typical of other strike fighters, but possessed a powerful sensor suite and command-and-control systems to boost [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] effectiveness. It sacrificed some maneuverability and speed for heavier defenses, and its secondary weapons were designed for eliminating stationary and armored targets.<ref name="GS" />
